An '''Antakarian Fire Dancer''' was a was a potent [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink. Its alcoholic stock was filtered through igneous rock and flavored with crushed gemstone. This thick ale was said to be popular with rough and tough types.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Antakarian Fire Dancer}}</ref> Ordering one at the [[Jaded Jawa]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] was a signal to the proprietor a desire to buy informaion from him. The beverage was available for four [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at a [[Stronghold Cantina|cantina]] in [[Nym's Stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].
